Title: Azure DevTest Labs: Use Azure Marketplace images to create VMs in the lab

Body.Content:
You can manage and use Azure Marketplace images in Azure DevTest Labs to create lab VMs, as long as the Marketplace images meet the following criteria:
  • The images create a single VM.
  • The images use Azure Resource Manager to provision VMs.
  • The images don't require purchasing an extra licensing plan.
You can update the lab settings to allow all qualified Azure Marketplace images in the lab or just some of them.
Allow all qualified Azure Marketplace images in the lab or select some of the images
When No is selected for Allow all Azure Marketplace images as VM bases, you can select the images that you want to allow in the lab, or you can select nothing so that none of the Azure Marketplace images can be used in the lab. Allowed Azure Marketplace images appear in the same list of VM bases with custom images when you create a lab VM.
Select an Azure Marketplace image as the base to create a lab VM
Please try it today and let us know what you think about it! If you have an idea for how to make it work better for you, submit your feedback (or vote for others) at the Azure DevTest Labs feedback forum. Have a question? Check out answers or ask a new question at the MSDN Community forum.
